features.name: Tool Proficiency

effects.note: You gain proficiency with the alchemist's supplies and with any other kind of smith's tools or Brewer's tools. The tools count as a single tool for your Intelligence checks.

features.summary: Expert proficiency with alchemist's supplies and smith's or brewer's tools
features.text: You gain proficiency with the alchemist's supplies and with any other kind of smith's tools or brewer's tools.

features.name: Experimental Elixir

effects.note: You can use a bonus action to drink a potion you have crafted with your Alchemist feature, as an action, and its effects are doubled. If the potion has a duration, it lasts until the end of that minute. At 6th level you gain a second use, at 10th a third, and at 14th a fourth, all regained on a long rest.

features.summary: Bonus action: drink a potion and double its effects
features.text: You can use a bonus action to drink a potion you have crafted with your Alchemist feature as an action, and its effects are doubled.

features.name: Alchemical Savant

effects.note: Your elixirs are more potent than other artificer's. When you finish a long rest, you can prepare one elixir that lasts for 1 hour and doubles its effects, without spending a slot on it. The elixir is an elixir of any type you can make.

features.summary: One free doubled elixir per long rest
features.text: Your elixirs are more potent than other artificer's. When you finish a long rest, you can prepare one elixir that lasts for 1 hour and doubles its effects.

features.name: Restorative Reagents

effects.note: As an action you can give a creature within reach a dose of your healing draught. You choose whether to create an elixir or an oil of healing. On a failed save, the target regains 1d8 plus your Intelligence modifier hit points, and at 10th level you can instead restore one of the creature's hit dice with 1d8 plus your Intelligence modifier.
Instead of healing hit points, you can restore one of the creature's hit dice with 1d8 plus your Intelligence modifier.

features.summary: Twice a long rest, heal an ally 1d8 + Int on a failed save
features.text: As an action you can give a creature within reach a dose of your healing draught. On a failed save, the target regains 1d8 plus your Intelligence modifier hit points.

features.name: Chemical Mastery

effects.note: The elixir you are carrying, and any creatures that drink it with you, do not provide a Constitution saving throw. The save only happens when you drink it yourself as a bonus action.

features.summary: Companions drinking your elixir skip the Con save
features.text: The elixir you are carrying, and any creatures that drink it with you, do not provide a Constitution saving throw.

features.name: Tools of the Trade

tools: any two other smith's or brewer's tools

effects.note: You gain proficiency with the armor's tools and with any two other kinds of smith's tools or brewer's tools. At 6th level you gain one more kind, and at 10th level another.

features.summary: Expert proficiency with armorer's tools plus two others
features.text: You gain proficiency with the armor's tools and with any two other kinds of smith's tools or brewer's tools.

features.name: Arcane Armor

effects.note: You gain proficiency with heavy armor. When you finish a long rest, you can make a suit of armor in 1 hour and get a +1 bonus to its AC, and at 10th level you get another +1. At 18th level you gain proficiency with shields.

tiers.summary: The bonus armor you make is +2 AC

features.summary: Heavy armor proficiency, and +1 AC to armor you forge
features.text: You gain proficiency with heavy armor. When you finish a long rest, you can make a suit of armor in 1 hour and get a +1 bonus to its AC.

features.name: Armor Model

effects.note: You can use an action to craft a magical armor model within reach from nonmagical materials. Any creature who wears the model gains +1 to AC and can see invisible creatures within 30 feet. The model lasts until you finish a long rest, and at 10th level its AC bonus is 2. At 18th level the model has a +2 AC bonus and lets a wearer see invisible creatures.

tiers.summary: The model's AC bonus is 2, and it works without the wearer

features.summary: Once a long rest, a +1 AC model that sees invisible creatures
features.text: You can use an action to craft a magical armor model within reach from nonmagical materials. Any creature who wears the model gains +1 to AC and can see invisible creatures within 30 feet.

features.name: Extra Attack

effects.note: You can attack twice, instead of once, whenever you take the Attack action on your turn.

features.summary: Two attacks with the Attack action
features.text: You can attack twice, instead of once, whenever you take the Attack action on your turn.

features.name: Armor Modifications

effects.note: When you finish a long rest, you can modify a suit of armor or a shield that you are wearing, giving it a magical bonus of your choice: a +1 bonus to AC, a +1 bonus to attack and damage rolls, or a +1 bonus to saving throws against a damage type. Each time you gain a level, you can modify a suit or shield once.

tiers.summary: One more modification per level, plus a +1 bonus to AC and saving throws
You no longer have disadvantage for Str (Dex) saves while adjacent to an ally

features.summary: Once a level, add a +1 bonus to armor or a shield you own
features.text: When you finish a long rest, you can modify a suit of armor or a shield that you are wearing, giving it a magical bonus of your choice: a +1 bonus to AC, a +1 bonus to attack and damage rolls, or a +1 bonus to saving throws.

features.name: Perfected Armor

effects.note: When you finish a long rest, you can modify a suit of armor or a shield that you are wearing, giving it a magical bonus of your choice: a +1 bonus to AC, a +1 bonus to attack and damage rolls, or a +1 bonus to saving throws. Any suit or shield you create this way gains a second benefit of your choice, and you also gain the following: no disadvantage on Strength or Dexterity saves while you are next to an ally.

features.summary: At 18th level, modified armor gains a second bonus
features.text: When you finish a long rest, you can modify a suit of armor or a shield that you are wearing, giving it a magical bonus of your choice. Any suit or shield you create this way gains a second benefit of your choice.

features.name: Eldritch Cannon

effects.note: You learn to make a magical cannon. When you finish a long rest, you can craft a Small wooden cannon in 1 hour and 25 gp. The cannon has 40 hit points, 15 of which are temporary, and you can use it to create various effects.

features.summary: Once a long rest, build a cannon with three abilities
features.text: You learn to make a magical cannon. When you finish a long rest, you can craft a Small wooden cannon in 1 hour and 25 gp.

features.name: Arcane Firearm

effects.note: Your elixir cannon creates a spell effect of your choice instead of dealing damage, as if by casting a spell with your Artificer Spellcasting features. You gain access to your artificer prepared spells and can cast one with an action, treating the cannon as an artifact. The damage type is fixed to acid if you choose acid, or you can use any of acid, fire, lightning or cold.

features.summary: Cast an artificer spell through your cannon
features.text: Your elixir cannon creates a spell effect of your choice instead of dealing damage, as if by casting a spell with your Artificer Spellcasting features.

features.name: Explosive Cannon

effects.note: If you loaded your elixir cannon with ammunition, you can use a bonus action to fire the cannon, dealing 3d8 fire damage plus your Intelligence modifier on a hit, or half as much on a save. At 15th level the damage is 3d10 plus your Intelligence modifier, and the creature is pushed 15 feet and must succeed on a Strength save or be knocked prone.
3d10 plus your Intelligence modifier, and the creature is pushed 15 feet and must succeed on a Strength saving throw or be knocked prone.

features.summary: Bonus action: fire the cannon for 3d8 + Int
features.text: If you loaded your elixir cannon with ammunition, you can use a bonus action to fire the cannon, dealing 3d8 fire damage plus your Intelligence modifier.

features.name: Fortified Position

effects.requires: you have half or three-quarters cover

effects.note: While you have half cover or three-quarters cover, you gain a +1 bonus to AC, and when you finish a long rest you can give your cannon the benefits of a half plate or +1 shield. At 18th level the bonus is +2 instead of +1.

effects.requires: you have half or three-quarters cover

effects.note: The AC bonus is +2 instead of +1.

features.summary: +1 AC while you have half or three-quarters cover
features.text: While you have half cover or three-quarters cover, you gain a +1 bonus to AC.

features.name: Battle Ready

effects.note: When you are attacked or targeted by a spell, you can use your reaction to gain a +2 bonus to AC until the start of your next turn, including against the triggering attack. At 6th level you can use this twice per long rest, and at 11th level three times.

features.summary: Reaction: +2 AC until your next turn when attacked
features.text: When you are attacked or targeted by a spell, you can use your reaction to gain a +2 bonus to AC until the start of your next turn.

features.name: Steel Defender

effects.note: When you finish a long rest, you can craft a steel defender in 1 hour and 500 gp. The defender is Small, has a AC of 17, 20 hit points, a speed of 40 ft, a +6 to hit, 1d8 + 4 piercing damage, and the ability to occupy a space you can see and within 5 feet of you or a creature you designate.

features.summary: Once a long rest, build a construct that fights on its own turn
features.text: When you finish a long rest, you can craft a steel defender in 1 hour and 500 gp. The defender is Small, has a +6 to hit, and 1d8 + 4 piercing damage.

features.name: Arcane Jolt

effects.note: The steel defender can, as a bonus action, teleport to a space within 5 feet of a creature you can see, and then make a thunder damage attack against it, dealing 2d6 thunder damage plus your Intelligence modifier and forcing a Strength save or being pushed 10 feet. At 15th level it deals 2d8 instead.
2d8 thunder damage instead of 2d6.

features.summary: Defender BA: blink to a target and hit it for 2d6 + Int
features.text: The steel defender can, as a bonus action, teleport to a space within 5 feet of a creature you can see, and then make a thunder damage attack against it.

features.name: Improved Defender

effects.note: The steel defender's Jolt feature deals 1d8 thunder damage plus its proficiency bonus in radiant damage, and the steel defender's hit points increase by 10, and its Arcane Jolt feature gains 1 extra use per long rest, and it can no longer be forced to take the stunned condition.

features.summary: Jolt adds radiant damage and more uses; more hit points
features.text: The steel defender's Jolt feature deals 1d8 thunder damage plus its proficiency bonus in radiant damage, and the steel defender's hit points increase by 10.
